Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.
Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.
You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).
This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.
Tasks
Your core mandate sits on three priorities.
1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health
Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.
2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation
Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.
3. Benchmark Reports and Growth
This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.
4. PPC Management and Optimization
Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Required
5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people
Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption.
Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations.
Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease.
Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't.
Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards.
A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges.

Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision
Experience building benchmark reports or original research content
Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems
B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software
Experience with PPC management and optimization

About Lumiform
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers.

Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy.
Shape a major growth channel from scratch. Benchmark reports and AEO strategy will drive significant value for the company
Work fully remote and choose where you get things done
If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough.

a veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs; or
a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
A “recently separated veteran” means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
An “active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran” means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
An “Armed forces service medal veteran” means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building new products that can reshape how finance teams operate. These products begin before the market playbook is obvious: the customer problem is still being sharpened, the product is evolving quickly, and the path from early signal to durable growth must be built.
We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager, New Products to lead that work. You will be embedded with Product and Engineering from the earliest stages, using customer and market insight to help choose the audience, shape the product, define the story, and build the commercialization and adoption motion.
This is not a launch-calendar or asset-production role. You will own the full business read for the product: customer problem, ICP, positioning, product readiness, launch, pipeline, activation, adoption, retention, proof, and the next product or GTM intervention.

Shape product strategy early. Bring customer, market, and competitive evidence into product decisions before the roadmap is fixed. Help the team identify the wedge, target segment, table stakes, differentiators, and highest-leverage problems to solve.
Find product-market clarity. Define the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, workflow, alternatives, and reasons customers will switch or expand.
Own the product narrative. Build the canonical positioning, messaging, claims, proof, and competitive story. Translate technical and operational complexity into a clear customer value proposition without flattening how the product works.
Design the zero-to-one GTM. Determine how the product should enter the market, including audience, channel, pricing and packaging inputs, sales motion, self-serve motion, launch sequence, and adoption plan.
Lead launches end to end. Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, Communications, Support, and other partners around one launch strategy, readiness bar, and set of measurable outcomes.
Build commercialization, not just awareness. Create the programs, enablement, proof, and feedback loops that turn interest into qualified pipeline, activation, retained usage, expansion, and revenue.
Work deeply with Product and Engineering. Understand the product's architecture, data, constraints, and trust model well enough to influence tradeoffs and explain it credibly to both technical and business audiences.
Create the customer learning system. Develop direct relationships with buyers and users, run structured discovery, capture objections and product gaps, and turn what you learn into product and GTM decisions.
Own the business scorecard. Define leading and lagging indicators, build a clear operating read, diagnose what is moving or stuck, and recommend the next intervention.
Build proof and competitive intelligence. Develop customer evidence, use cases, benchmarks, and a current view of the market that improve both product decisions and GTM execution.
Use AI as an operating advantage. Apply AI to research, synthesis, analysis, content development, and repeatable workflows—and help the team raise its standard for speed and quality.
Create the new-products playbook. Build a repeatable method for taking an emerging product from customer signal to product-market clarity, launch, commercialization, and scaled growth.
What you'll need
6+ years of experience in B2B software product marketing, product management, growth, strategy, or another product-led GTM function, including significant ownership of a product or business outcome.
Demonstrated zero-to-one experience with a new product, category, platform, or business line—from early customer discovery through launch and adoption.
A record of influencing product strategy using customer, market, competitive, and performance evidence.
Strong customer instincts. You can run discovery, identify the real workflow and buying problem, and separate a loud request from a durable market signal.
Technical and operational fluency. You can learn a complex product, work credibly with Product and Engineering, and explain how it works to different audiences.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can produce a sharp product narrative, an executive recommendation, a launch plan, and a sales story that survives contact with customers.
Strong data literacy. You can define and interpret activation, adoption, retention, pipeline, conversion, revenue, and product-usage metrics and turn the findings into a decision.
Proven ability to lead senior partners across Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, and Marketing without relying on formal authority.
High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You build the first version, test it with customers, make tradeoffs, and improve it quickly.
Fluency with AI tools as part of your everyday research, analysis, writing, and operating workflows.

Experience in fintech, payments, accounts receivable, accounting, developer tools, data infrastructure, AI, or another technical and workflow-heavy category.
Experience taking a product from incubation through product-market fit and scaled commercialization.
Experience with both product-led and sales-led growth motions.
Experience contributing to pricing and packaging decisions.
Experience as an early or founding PMM, product manager, founder, or operator in a fast-moving product area.

Hay Day is one of Supercell’s most iconic games, delighting tens of millions of players worldwide with its cozy, social farming experience. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and execution – turning every update, feature drop, and seasonal moment into a campaign our players and community can’t stop talking about.
Sitting directly within the Hay Day game team, you will bridge product development, live ops, creative production, and community to turn product updates into major commercial and player-engagement wins.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive End-to-End GTM Strategy: Partner directly with product leads and game designers from early feature concepts to define positioning, formulate clear pre-launch hypotheses, and deliver high-impact marketing campaigns for all live updates, seasonal beats, and feature drops.
Lead Creative Campaign Delivery: Direct internal art directors, video producers, and external agencies to produce compelling trailers, visual assets, and marketing collateral that land with Hay Day’s core audience.
Explore Growth Channels with UA: Partner closely with UA and Performance Marketing teams to test and scale performance-driven channels including Connected TV (CTV), influencer integrations, creator platforms, and podcasts and more to expand game reach during major moments.
In-Game & Channel Execution: Operationalize player communications across in-game pop-ups, newsfeed beats, push notifications, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Web Shop / D2C channels.
Amplify via Community & Creators: Collaborate with Community Managers and content creators to design shareable launch beats that drive organic reach and creator content.
Measure & Iterate: Partner with analytics to validate campaign hypotheses, track launch performance, feature adoption, and player sentiment—using post-launch data to continuously sharpen future GTM playbooks.
What You Have
5+ years of Product Marketing experience in mobile gaming or live-service consumer products (casual, simulation, or puzzle experience is a big plus).
Proven GTM execution track record: Demonstrated experience taking live features and product updates from early concept to full public launch.
Sharp creative instincts: Strong aesthetic eye with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback on trailer cuts, visual assets, and player copy.
Performance channel & UA literacy: Solid understanding of performance marketing mechanics and experience evaluating multi-channel campaigns (UA, CTV, creator partnerships, podcasts).
Data & Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: Experience framing clear GTM hypotheses, defining success metrics pre-launch, and using post-campaign analytics to back up strategic decisions.
Cross-functional leadership: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to align developers, artists, and marketers without formal authority.
Collaborative mindset: Naturally builds trust, communicates openly, and thrives in cross-functional teams. Partner with analytics and support the insights team.
Where You'll Be
You are based in or willing to relocate to Helsinki, Finland. Alternatively, located in London with a willingness to travel.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,

Vos missions
Doctolib est le leader technologique et de l’IA en santé, avec l’ambition de transformer la santé en Europe. Alors que nous enrichissons notre suite de technologies et d’assistants IA couvrant l’ensemble des activités des soignants, nous voulons renforcer la perception de Doctolib auprès des professionnels de santé et affirmer notre rôle de partenaire technologique de référence.
En tant que B2B Brand Manager, vous transformez nos enjeux business, nos propositions de valeur et les besoins des soignants en positionnements distinctifs, campagnes créatives et plans d’activation à fort impact pour le marché français. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Social Media, Content, Product Marketing, Performance, Brand Design et Communication, ainsi qu’avec nos agences créatives et média.

s.h: Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à
s.t:
Positionnement stratégique : collaborer avec les Product Marketing Managers pour construire des positionnements différenciants pour nos produits et clusters, en traduisant les enjeux business et les besoins des soignants en récits de marque clairs et convaincants.
Stratégie d’activation : concevoir des plans d’activation intégrés en définissant les formats, canaux et contenus les plus pertinents selon les audiences, les objectifs et les étapes du funnel.
Campagnes 360° : imaginer et piloter des campagnes associant communication omnicanale, activations, événements, social media et formats digitaux, de la réflexion stratégique jusqu’au déploiement média.
Messaging & copywriting : transformer nos propositions de valeur en messages simples, distinctifs et mémorables, puis les adapter avec précision aux différents canaux et formats.
Excellence créative : rédiger des briefs exigeants, accompagner et challenger les agences, designers et partenaires de production afin de garantir un niveau d'exécution élevé sur chaque prise de parole.
Pilotage de projets : orchestrer les projets de bout en bout, en assurant la coordination des équipes, la maîtrise des budgets, le respect des calendriers et la qualité des livrables.
Mesure de la performance : définir les KPIs, consolider les résultats des campagnes et transformer les enseignements en recommandations concrètes pour les prochaines activations.
Amélioration continue : partager les insights de campagne avec les autres équipes afin d’affiner nos positionnements, nos messages et nos stratégies d’activation.

About the Customer Marketing team
Customer Marketing is a new team at Teachable, an evolved scope from the previous Product Marketing team, that plays a critical role in connecting customer insight, product adoption, and business outcomes.

Our team leans toward go-to-market and post-launch impact, owning positioning, messaging, enablement, and adoption, working closely with Product and Customer Success to ensure solutions land, stick, and scale.

This role sits within that team and is focused specifically on understanding our customers deeply and helping them succeed with our products over time.

We're hiring a Senior Customer Marketing Manager to put the customer at the center of how we drive adoption and growth. This role is built around a simple loop: go deep with customers to uncover their real stories, partner with Product to shape and validate those stories, and then turn them into enablement that Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales can use to drive adoption, retention, and expansion.
This person will lead structured customer interviews, feedback loops, and voice-of-customer research, to identify the moments where customers get the most value from our products. Working closely with Product, they'll turn those moments into credible, success stories and proof points that reflect how customers actually use and benefit from what we build.
From there, this role owns translating those stories into practical enablement: case studies, adoption plays, lifecycle content, and sales-ready assets, in close partnership with Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales, so every team has what it needs to help customers adopt, stay, and grow with us.

About The Role Great products earn three different stories: the one that wins today's market, the one that opens tomorrow's, and the one that proves the architecture underneath both is right.

We're hiring three Product Marketing Managers for our product-facing team, reporting to the Director of Product Marketing (Product). This function owns positioning IP for what we build, while GTM Product Marketing activates it in market.

Core Markets. Our established product lines and the verticals that generate the bulk of Fundraise Up 's ARR, including existing nonprofit segments and cause and cure organizations.

Platform & Core Products. Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
Over 200,000 businesses run on DeepL, and their stories are the most persuasive asset we have. This role puts them front and centre across brand, demand and growth. Buyers evaluating Language AI trust other buyers. We're building the proof that puts customer stories in front of them at scale.
You'll sit in Product Marketing, report to the VP, and work at pace with Field, Brand, Digital, Comms and PR.

Amplify our customers’ success : Surface the stories our customers are already telling within support tickets, sales nominations, deal wins and win-loss interviews, and choose the few that deserve to become full stories. Ship marquee stories (blue-chip, video, event-ready), named case studies and quantified proof points that show DeepL's AI doing real work in real businesses.
Put our customers on the world stage: Press interviews, webinars, keynotes and our Customer Advisory Board advocacy track. You recommend who speaks, agree the narrative with them in advance, and make each appearance count beyond the day itself..
Put a real customer in front of every buyer: Sales and Customer Success come to you when a deal needs a reference. You'll know which customers will speak, what they'll speak about, and how recently each was asked. Sales enablement builds the seller tools - you supply the customers and the proof that goes inside them.
Share stories while they still matter: Stories work hardest published alongside a launch, event or campaign they belong to. You own the run from interview to live asset, including the legal and brand engagement, and keep customer permissions current so nothing sits waiting.
Measures of success (first 12 months)
New marquee stories the field, brand and events teams all pull from.
Named case studies covering every region, product lines and priority verticals
Reference requests resolved within the agreed turnaround time
Stories publishing in the same window as the launch or event they belong to
Clear evidence that deals using a customer reference close at a better rate
Qualities we look for
Proven success in B2B marketing, over many years: customer marketing, content, comms or advocacy, with a track record of stories that engaged buyers and moved deals
Bias for action: you're a self-starter who clears your own hurdles. You do not wait for a brief
Automate before you escalate: when a step is slow, your instinct is to build a way round it. AI is already in your workflow, not on your list of things to try.
Storytelling: genuine curiosity about a customer's business problem, and the instinct to find the narrative inside it
Customer-facing polish: comfortable with customers from first discovery call through to launch
Strategic judgement: you can map advocacy output to our priorities and back the stories that serve them
Operational rigour: you have built the production, approvals and permissions process - and made it fast

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We're on a mission
Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.

You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.
The problems you'll own
Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.
Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.
Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.
From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.
The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.
Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.
Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.
This could be for you if
You're an excellent communicator, above all. Writing is the craft at the centre of this job. You make complex things simple without making them shallow, you have taste, and it shows in everything you put out.
You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.
You thrive on the team's success. You get more from a customer win or a teammate's great launch than from your own byline. Small team, shared scoreboard.
You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.
You ship at startup pace. You put things out, learn, and go again, rather than polishing one thing for a month, and you do it without waiting for a brief.
Tooling fluency helps. Comfort with a CMS, email platforms, CRMs and basic design is a real advantage.
What you'll get
You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

Blavity Inc. is looking for a temporary Email Marketing Coordinator . This role will own the full newsletter production schedule across four brands Blavity, AfroTech, Travel Noire, and HealthStack while maintaining audience health and contributing to weekly KPI reporting.
This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. The ideal candidate has direct experience with Iterable and can build and send 6-8 newsletters per day across a mix of RSS-automated and fully manual builds with confidence.

All workflows are documented; the expectation is that you follow established processes precisely while flagging issues clearly and escalating when needed. The ideal candidate will implement updates including newsletter redesigns, send time optimization, and template rebuilds, as directed without disrupting the send schedule.
This role will report to the Director of Growth Marketing.

Send Execution (primary focus)
Own 6-8 newsletter sends per day across four brands, building each according to documented workflows and the established send calendar
Execute a mix of RSS-automated and fully manual builds, each requiring property-specific preparation work completed before every send
Apply editorial judgment to manual properties, drawing on content performance data to inform curation decisions
Communicate proactively and professionally with editorial, creative, and engineering stakeholders providing timely status updates, flagging blockers early, and escalating issues with clear context
Administer Pre-Send QA, a checklist that covers copy and content, links and assets, suppression and compliance, audience and list integrity, technical rendering, and scheduling
Maintain a clear, up-to-date picture of your full send schedule and build windows, and communicate proactively when that schedule is affected.
KPI & Benchmark Reporting
Maintain weekly audience snapshots and list health metrics across all properties
Contribute to bi-weekly KPI reporting, highlighting editorial newsletter metrics and trends
Communicate proactively on task status, including when work is in progress or behind
Platform Coordination
Navigate Iterable across its full feature set: campaign builds, audience management, analytics, and template tools
Identify and document platform issues clearly, distinguishing between platform-side problems and execution errors, and escalate to the right team with full context

Hands-on experience with Iterable is required. You must be able to navigate campaign builds, audience lists, segmentation, and drag-and-drop templates from day one.
Experience managing high-volume email production: multiple properties, multiple sends per week, across a mix of automated and manual workflows
Demonstrated QA discipline: ability to follow a multi-step checklist under time pressure without skipping steps
Ability to read campaign analytics and identify patterns: open rates, click-through rates, engagement data
Strong process discipline: documented workflows must be followed exactly; the ability to execute consistently without reinventing the approach is essential
Clear communication: proactive about flagging blockers, escalating issues, and reporting progress, even when work is incomplete
Ability to research answers independently using available tools before escalating. Comfort using AI tools and platform-native resources to get unstuck is expected.
Proficiency in Claude, Google Suite, and Asana

HTML/CSS for email
Google Analytics for editorial content performance analysis
Experience with editorial newsletter properties serving Black and multicultural audiences
What Success Looks Like
A strong temp in this role is reliable, motivated, data-centric, and communicative. In the first 30 days, success means:
All newsletters go out on schedule with no missed sends
Every send has a completed QA checklist and documented approval before it goes out
Briefings, inclusions, and list snapshots are completed before deadlines without reminders
Platform and content issues are flagged to the manager quickly, with clear context
KPI data is entered accurately with anomalies noted
Slack messages are acknowledged; the manager is never uncertain whether instructions have been seen
Each send reflects the brand it represents. Voice, standards, and audience expectations are understood and applied consistently.
At 60–90 days, success means the team continues operating at its normal pace or better with in-flight design and strategy projects progressing on schedule.

Seoul is one of Tinder's key global hubs — home to cross-functional product pods building for hundreds of millions of members across 160+ countries. Our Seoul-based teams span Product, Design, Engineering (iOS, Android, web, and backend), and Data, working side by side to move fast: incubating new ideas, running rapid experiments, and shipping features that scale from a single market to Tinder's global business.

We partner closely with teams across the region and our U.S. headquarters, taking what works locally — new experiences, growth strategies, product bets — and turning it into playbooks and products that shape how Tinder shows up for members everywhere.

Launched in 2012, Tinder revolutionized how people meet and has become one of the world’s most popular apps for meeting new people. With tens of millions of users globally, Tinder continues to shape culture, spark conversations, and redefine how a new generation connects.

At Tinder, we believe meaningful connections start with authenticity, curiosity, and self-expression. We’re looking for a highly driven and culturally fluent Marketing Manager to help grow and evolve Tinder’s brand presence in Korea.

This role will drive locally relevant brand and growth marketing strategies across campaigns, social, influencers, partnerships, CRM, product marketing, and consumer engagement initiatives. The ideal candidate deeply understands Korean youth culture and digital behavior, while also being highly comfortable operating within a fast-moving global organization.

You should be someone who can execute hands-on, collaborate cross-functionally, and constantly identify new ways to make Tinder culturally relevant and commercially impactful in Korea.
You will work closely with local, regional, and global stakeholders across Marketing, Product Marketing, Social, CRM, Comms, Legal, Media, and Partnerships teams.

This will be a 2-year contractor role.

Manage the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies and campaigns across paid, owned, earned, social, influencer, CRM, experiential, and digital channels
Drive culturally relevant and insight-led marketing initiatives that strengthen Tinder’s brand relevance, engagement, and growth in Korea
Partner closely with creative and media agencies, PR/Comms, CRM, Product Marketing, Legal and other relevant regional stakeholders to deliver impactful 360 campaigns from ideation through execution
Manage and work closely with digital media agencies to oversee media planning, budget allocation, channel strategy, campaign optimization, and performance reporting across digital platforms
Lead social-first marketing initiatives including influencer, creator, partnership, and content-driven campaigns that can generate conversation, engagement, and earned amplification
Analyze campaign, audience, and business result data to drive optimization, improve ROI, and support data-informed decision making
When required, help shape and execute in-app user engagement and feature adoption initiatives in partnership with CRM and Product Marketing teams
Manage marketing budgets, timelines, agencies, and external partners effectively while ensuring operational excellence
Ensure all local executions align with Tinder’s global brand principles while maximizing local cultural relevance and market impact

5–8 years of experience in Brand Marketing, Growth Marketing and/or Digital Marketing.
Experience within consumer tech, digital platforms, entertainment, gaming, lifestyle or other culturally driven brands preferred
Strong understanding of Korean youth culture, digital behavior, social platforms, internet culture, and evolving consumer trends
Proven experience leading integrated multi-channel campaigns across paid media, social, influencer, CRM, partnerships, and experiential marketing
Hands-on experience managing digital media strategy and execution across platforms such as Meta, Google (incl YouTube), TikTok, Kakao, Naver, X and other digital ecosystems

Data-savvy with the ability to interpret campaign and consumer insights and translate them into actionable marketing strategies
Strong storytelling, communication, and presentation skills in both Korean and English
Ability to balance global alignment with local cultural nuance and relevance

Naturally curious about culture, relationships, and evolving consumer behaviors
Strong sense of judgment and attention to nuance
Proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented mindset
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities
Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership, adaptability, and problem-solving capabilities

As part of the Demand Generation team and reporting to the Director, Regional Marketing, Strategic & Key Accounts, you will play a critical role in driving integrated demand generation, account engagement, and pipeline acceleration across Okta’s highest-value account segments. You will support both the Strategic Accounts Marketing team and the Key Accounts Marketing team by executing a multi-channel integrated framework that moves target accounts through the buyer journey.
This role requires a collaborative, energetic, creative, team-minded, and detail-oriented marketer. You will act as a force multiplier by establishing foundational mechanisms that the team operates upon, looking for continuous opportunities to optimize programs, operations, and reporting, and leveraging AI to streamline and automate workflows to consistently raise the bar for execution.

s.h: THE TILT: WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT
s.t:
We are seeking a proactive marketer who cares personally about team success while bringing energy, discipline, and creativity to daily execution:
Integrated Multi-Channel Framework: Supporting both Strategic and Key Accounts, you will help connect field events, direct mail, digital activations, and peer intelligence initiatives into cohesive, high-impact account journeys.
Foundational Mechanisms & Optimization: Rather than just executing single tactics, you will help build and refine operational mechanisms, playbooks, and reporting structures that optimize how our entire team operates.
AI-Driven Efficiency: You will actively embrace Generative AI and modern automation tools to optimize processes, accelerate content creation, and eliminate administrative friction to continually raise our bar.

Strategic Program Support & Campaign Optimization
Support campaign and program builds: Partner closely with regional marketing managers to assist in the setup, asset coordination, and logistics for field marketing events, executive dinners, VIP receptions, and targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABx) campaigns.
Optimize multi-channel nurtures & customer journeys: Work directly with Marketing Operations to analyze, update, and optimize email nurture sequences through a strategic account lens, unlocking continuous improvements in account engagement and conversion.
Maintain visibility & alignment across team initiatives: Stay deeply plugged into all active regional campaigns across Strategic and Key Accounts to ensure central communication mechanisms, field newsletters, and team playbooks remain accurate and continuously updated.
Serve as key data & operational problem solver: Act as the primary point of contact for troubleshooting data discrepancies, lead routing issues, and campaign tracking errors across Salesforce and Tableau to preserve reporting integrity.
Marketing Operations, Event Logistics & Mechanisms
Manage comprehensive event logistics and vendor relations , encompassing venue sourcing, webinar/platform setup, swag replenishment, and Purchase Order (PO) creation.
Instill and maintain foundational team mechanisms , tracking systems, and operational templates to drive execution rigor, consistency, and business continuity across the Strategic and Key Account segments.
Leverage AI tools and automated workflows to streamline daily operations, optimize reporting, and automate repetitive tasks across assigned programs.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Enablement
Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across Strategic & Key Accounts: Collaborate closely with Regional Marketing Managers (RMMs), Sales, SDRs, Campaigns, Strategic Events, and Product Marketing to align on target account priorities, drive shared revenue outcomes, and systematically capture and share best practices across the broader marketing team.
Lead field sales communication efforts by owning and delivering weekly strategic field marketing newsletters and campaign alerts, positioning marketing campaigns as actionable pipeline levers.
Manage centralized tools and playbooks , such as "Go-To Guides" and Regional Decks, to increase field visibility, standardize marketing plays, and drive field adoption.
Lead Management & Automated Workflows
Oversee campaign enablement and lead management by building localized registration pages (e.g., Splash), crafting urgency-driven invite copy, and establishing white-glove post-event lead routing.
Architect automated follow-up sequences that alert Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to engage prospects, providing them with templated messaging, conversation starters, and account intelligence to accelerate outreach.
Data Analytics, Reporting & Program Optimization
Develop and standardize actionable reporting frameworks for event registration, attendance tracking, and target account intent using Salesforce, 6sense, and marketing analytics platforms.
Empower sales and marketing teams with data-driven insights , leveraging analytics to pivot strategies in real time, evaluate program ROI, and optimize regional targeting strategies.

2+ years of professional B2B tech marketing experience (field marketing, demand generation, or account-based marketing preferred).
Bachelor’s Degree ; Marketing, Communications, or Business preferred.
Experience with marketing and sales technology , including CRM (Salesforce) and Marketing Automation platforms (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua).
Familiarity with ABM platforms and modern tools (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase), event management software (e.g., Splash, Zoom), and project management applications (e.g., Asana).
Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and analyze program performance.
Strong analytical abilities with a passion for working with data, analyzing outcomes, and scoping out key insights to establish continuous optimization.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with a keen attention to detail.
Self-starter mindset who excels at multitasking, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and demonstrates a positive, team-first growth mindset.

Champion the player perspective throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring features, systems, and content are positioned in ways that resonate with our diverse player base
Establish messaging frameworks that create consistency across every player-facing touchpoint, from launch campaigns and CRM to roadmap communications and in-game messaging

Ensure every major release tells a clear story that connects product innovation with meaningful player outcomes

Build launch plans that align messaging, timing, audiences, business objectives, and player education across every player-facing channel

Review and approve marketing assets to ensure consistency across channels and alignment with product strategy, brand standards, and franchise guidelines

Measure Product Adoption & Optimize Performance

Translate quantitative and qualitative player insights into actionable recommendations for future launches and product improvements
Continuously refine positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies through experimentation, testing, and post-launch analysis
Lead the Product Marketing Function
Lead and evolve the Product Marketing discipline for Star Trek Fleet Command, continuously improving launch quality, planning processes, and organizational effectiveness
Manage the Campaign Manager, providing coaching, prioritization, and strategic direction across day-to-day marketing execution
Own the Product Marketing operating cadence, including roadmap reviews, launch planning, partner coordination, and cross-functional alignment
Build trusted relationships across Product, Marketing, Creative, Publishing, Licensing, and executive leadership to improve decision-making and execution
Establish scalable frameworks, documentation, and best practices that strengthen Product Marketing's impact across the organization

Strategic, curious, and relentlessly player-focused
Comfortable operating at the intersection of product strategy, marketing, and player experience
Motivated by turning complex systems into simple, compelling stories that players understand and value
Collaborative by nature, bringing diverse teams together around a shared vision and common goals
Equally confident leading strategic discussions with executives and producing hands-on deliverables that move launches forward

Adaptable in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve and every launch presents new opportunities to learn

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
The Product Marketing Team plays a critical role in connecting product, marketing, and revenue. Our role combines strategy, storytelling, and market analysis to drive the growth of our platform. We are looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager to own the Go-To-Market for one of DeepL’s core product areas.
In this role, you will own and lead the GTM strategy for one of DeepL’s key product areas, shaping how we deliver value to the world's most demanding enterprises. You will act as a strategic thinker who distills market insights and competitive analysis into a clear vision, collaborating closely with product development, sales, and customer success to ensure the successful launch and ongoing promotion of our capabilities within the platform.

Own the end-to-end Product Marketing strategy and execution for capabilities within the DeepL Translator product line , defining how the world understands DeepL’s value and differentiation.
Inform the product roadmap by distilling market, competitive, and customer insights into actionable requirements .
Translate complex AI capabilities and foundational research into clear, outcome-driven messaging that differentiates our core offerings from the rest of the market.
Lead the planning and execution of global product launches , coordinating across Marketing, Product, and Revenue teams to drive awareness and user adoption.
Collaborate with the Sales Enablement team to provide global revenue teams with the training and assets needed to position our products effectively against competitors and measure how consistently they win.
Partner with marketing and Revenue teams on a unified strategy that drives platform awareness, demand creation and long-term user retention
Qualities we look for
6+ years of professional experience in Marketing, Product, or Revenue, with at least 4 years in B2B Product Marketing .
A full-stack PMM who can move seamlessly between high-level strategy, competitive positioning and tactical revenue enablement.
Proven success in driving go-to-market strategies for complex technologies or platform-level products.
A natural storyteller with the ability to translate highly technical concepts into narratives that resonate with enterprise decision-makers.
High level of comfort navigating ambiguity and using data-driven insights to solve complex problems in a fast-moving environment.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience working with product development, research, and sales teams .
AI native, comfortable using AI tooling to scale your own work and a deep curiosity for how language technology is evolving for the enterprise.
Fluency in English and a passion for languages and communication.

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

Das Blaue Netzwerk, ein Projekt von Atrium Environmental, unterstützt gemeinwohlorientierte KMU, Start-ups und NGOs der Blauen Wirtschaft auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Nachhaltigkeit und Gemeinwohlorientierung. Mit Workshops, Vernetzungsangeboten und digitalen Formaten stärken wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Geschäftsmodelle nachhaltig und zukunftsfähig auszurichten.
Aufgaben
Wir suchen zum 01.10.2026 eine Persönlichkeit (m/w/d), die unser Programm sowohl im Bereich Sales als auch Marketing aktiv voranbringt. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Stelle liegt auf Akquise und Vertrieb: Du gewinnst neue Teilnehmende für unser Programm und begleitest sie bis zur Teilnahme.

Gleichzeitig baust du unsere bereits gut etablierte Marketing-Präsenz weiter aus – Social Media, Blog und Website sind vorhanden und funktionieren; du pflegst diese Kanäle, veröffentlichst Inhalte in Abstimmung mit dem Team und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter.
Eine zentrale Aufgabe wird es sein, einen strukturierten Marketing- und Sales-Plan zu etablieren, der transparente Einblicke in Erfolge und Herausforderungen ermöglicht und als Grundlage für zukunftsorientierte Planung dient. Du bringst deine Expertise ein, um unsere bestehenden Maßnahmen zu optimieren und neue Ansätze zu implementieren, die unsere Reichweite und Wirkung nachhaltig steigern.
Deine Aufgaben
Sales & Akquise (Schwerpunkt)
Aktive Gewinnung neuer Teilnehmender für unser Programm (KMU, Start-ups, NGOs)
Zielgerichtete Ansprache über Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn und auf Veranstaltungen – inkl. echter Outbound-Akquise
Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen; enge Abstimmung mit den Expert:innen im Team
Begleitung von Interessent:innen bis zur Teilnahme / Vertragsunterzeichnung
Saubere Pflege und Dokumentation aller Kontakte in unserem CRM (Bigin by Zoho): Jeder Kontakt wird zeitnah erfasst und nachverfolgt
Marketing & Kommunikation (bestehendes Fundament pflegen)
Umsetzung und Ausbau des bestehenden Marketingplans für LinkedIn, Instagram, Website.
Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Social-Media-Beiträgen (organisch und gesponsert)
Gestaltung von Werbematerialien (One-Pager, Präsentationen, Social-Media-Grafiken)
Laufende Analyse von Reichweite, Engagement und Conversions; kurze Reports ans Team
Website & Content (aktuell halten)

Veranstaltungen & Präsenz

Repräsentation von Das Blaue Netzwerk; Reisebereitschaft bei Bedarf

Du wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen mit (Lead-Qualität, Ansprache, Content-Planung)
Qualifikation
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in aktiver B2B-Akquise / im Vertrieb (Telefon, Pipeline, Abschluss) – das ist uns wichtig
Erfahrung im Social-Media-Management (insb. LinkedIn) und in der Content-Erstellung
Sicherer Umgang mit einem Website-Baukasten (z. B. Wix) reicht aus; die Website ist bereits aufgebaut
CRM-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus;
Canva-Kenntnisse hilfreich
Strukturierte, ergebnisorientierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise; du kommunizierst transparent
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Freude an Nachhaltigkeit, Gemeinwohlorientierung und der maritimen / blauen Wirtschaft
Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Ausbildung – oder Quereinstieg mit relevanter Vertriebserfahrung

Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einem wachstumsorientierten Projekt mit gesellschaftlicher Wirkung
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten (Kiel + Remote nach Absprache)
Ein kollegiales, offenes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir teilen offen, was funktioniert und was nicht – und wollen deinen Input
Befristete Anstellung 01.10.2026 – 31.10.2027, Vollzeit oder 80%
Bitte sende uns dein kurzes Anschreiben, deinen Lebenslauf und relevante Arbeitsproben per E-Mail.
Eine Bitte für dein Anschreiben: Schau dir unseren LinkedIn-Auftritt an und nenn uns eine konkrete Sache, die du ändern würdest, um mehr passende KMU und Start-ups zu erreichen.

Du liebst Sport, gesunde Ernährung und nachhaltige Snacks? Du weißt, wie man aus einer guten Geschäftsidee eine Marke macht, die im Gedächtnis bleibt und im Regal auffällt?
Bei TZAMPAS stehen wir vor dem nächsten großen Schritt: Wir haben ein starkes Produkt, aber unsere Markenbotschaft muss noch schärfer, konsistenter und bekannter werden. Wenn du Lust hast, unser Markenprofil auf den Punkt zu bringen und mit kreativen Kampagnen für echte Reichweite zu sorgen, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Wir suchen eine Teilzeitkraft für 20-25 Std./Woche mit der Option auf Vollzeit in der Zukunft.
Aufgaben
Als Brand & Marketing Manager:in bist du das Sprachrohr und das strategische Gewissen unserer Marke. Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, TZAMPAS eine glasklare Identität zu verleihen und die Markenbekanntheit spürbar zu steigern.
Markengeschichte & Botschaft schärfen: Du entwickelst unsere Core Message und ein klares Brand Playbook (Tone of Voice, Wording, Design-Leitplanken), damit TZAMPAS auf allen Kanälen - von der Verpackung über Social Media bis zum POS - wie aus einem Guss kommuniziert.
Bekanntheit aufbauen: Du konzipierst und steuerst kreative Kampagnen (z. B. Influencer-Kooperationen, Event-Sponsoring im Outdoor-/Sportbereich, PR und Social-Media-Aktionen) mit Fokus auf Reichweite und Markenaufbau.
Kanalübergreifende Konsistenz: Du achtest darauf, dass sowohl D2C (Onlineshop) als auch der B2B-Auftritt (Supermärkte/Handel) dieselbe starke Markensprache sprechen.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit
Erfahrung im Branding: Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Brand Management, Marketing oder einer Agentur (bevorzugt FMCG, Food oder Lifestyle).
Fokus auf klare Kommunikation: Du kannst komplexe oder vielschichtige Themen (z. B. Nachhaltigkeit, pflanzliche Ernährung) auf einfache, prägnante und mitreißende Botschaften herunterbrechen.
Macher-Mentalität: Du denkst strategisch, hast aber genauso Freude daran, Ideen eigenständig und pragmatisch umzusetzen (Hands-on-Mentalität).
Leidenschaft für das Thema: Du lebst gesunde Ernährung, Nachhaltigkeit oder Sport und verstehst die Sprache unserer Zielgruppe intuitiv.
Grafische Skills: Du hast ein gutes Auge für Design und kannst kleinere Grafik-Tasks auch selbst umsetzen.
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du behältst auch bei einer Vielzahl unterschiedlicher Aufgaben die Übersicht.
Deutschkenntnisse: Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachenniveau in Wort und Schrift sind unabdingbar für deine Aufgaben.
Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung im Aufbau von Communitys oder der Zusammenarbeit mit Influencern aus dem Outdoor-/Fitnessbereich.

Darum TZAMPAS
Echter Einfluss: Du übernimmst direkt die Verantwortung für das Gesicht und die Stimme einer aufstrebenden Food-Marke.
Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice nach Absprache
Sinnstiftendes Produkt: Ein Produkt, hinter dem man zu 100 % stehen kann, faire Arbeitsbedingungen und ein motiviertes, unkompliziertes Team.
Schicke uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellungen bezogen auf eine 20 - Stundenwoche sowie 2-3 Beispiele von Marken oder Projekten, deren Botschaft du geschärft oder deren Bekanntheit du gesteigert hast (z. B. als kurzes PDF oder Link).

Account Based Marketing Specialist
Location: United States
SweetRush has an exciting opportunity for a talented professional to join our Marketing team!
Who We Are
At SweetRush , we believe that when you put people at the center of business, magic happens. As a global leader in learning and development, we blend high-end storytelling, emerging tech like AI and VR, and deep psychological insights to help organizations—from iconic global brands to essential nonprofits—flourish.

We are a remote-first, tight-knit community built on a foundation of radical empathy and creative excellence. Our work isn’t just about the awards we win with incredible partners such as Hilton, Google, Bridgestone, Adidas, SHRM, and numerous others; it’s about balancing profit with a genuine desire to spread good in the world.

If you are a caring innovator who believes work should be life-centered and impactful, then this is where you come in…
About the Opportunity
Most account-based marketing fails for a simple reason: people try to scale personal connections using cookie-cutter templates. They swap a logo on a deck, throw a first name into an email subject line, and call it personalization. We don't work that way, and we're looking for an ABM Specialist who doesn't either.
In this role, you’ll be looking at our most critical accounts as groups of actual human beings with specific challenges, pressures, and goals. Your job is to take what our sales and marketing teams know about these accounts and turn it into thoughtful, creative outreach that makes a learning leader pause and think, "Finally, someone who actually gets what we're going through."
SweetRush messaging is always deeply personal and deeply human. What you create should feel authentic and real - not blending in with an ocean of AI-created emails.
You need to know the learning and development world well enough to speak its language without sounding like a textbook. You should be as comfortable digging into data to see what’s working as you are coming up with a creative concept that breaks through the noise. Most importantly, you bring genuine curiosity and respect for the craft.

This is a pro-active position for someone who will take the lead to think about how we can build something useful, memorable, and human for the real people on the other side of the screen.

Develop and execute ABM and demand generation campaigns specifically targeting the L&D industry.
Partner closely with Sales and Marketing Leadership (Directors and Account Management Team Lead) to identify, prioritize, and refine target accounts and buyer personas.
Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across digital platforms and owned assets to drive engagement within key accounts.
Design and run synchronized ABM “plays” across channels, ensuring consistent and personalized messaging that aligns with SweetRush 's voice and brand.
Measure campaign performance, analyze results, and continuously optimize tactics to improve ROI and conversion rates.
Support alignment between Marketing and Sales teams, ensuring smooth handoff of qualified opportunities and consistent follow-through.
Collaborate with Sales and Marketing Design teams to develop on-brand, high-impact campaigns and assets.
Write tailored communication assets such as emails, brochures, and landing pages to support account engagement.
Maintain and manage campaign data within CRM systems (HubSpot experience preferred).
Ensure close attention to detail in campaign execution, reporting, and data integrity.

Familiarity with the Learning & Development (L&D) industry is highly desirable.
5+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, with at least 2 years focused on ABM or Field Marketing.
Proven experience in Account-Based Marketing and/or demand generation.
Strong understanding of B2B service company marketing strategies and buyer journeys.

s.h: Hands-on experience with CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred).
s.t:
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into actionable improvements.
Excellent campaign management and organizational skills.
Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.
Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally with Sales and Marketing teams.

Experience with structured data/schema markup, semantic search, and AI-search optimization (GEO/AEO).
Proven ability to manage agencies, contractors, and external development resources.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to engage with technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across teams and time zones.

Systems Thinking : Ability to visualize how web, content, and search systems connect to drive meaningful business outcomes across the buyer journey.

About Anthropic

This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners.

When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end.
Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches — the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side.
You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work.

This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners — briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together.

You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners.
The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you.
Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it.

Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem — from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting
Define the operating model for partner launches: set the standard for what readiness means, decide what's durable enough to share and when, and own the trade-offs when timelines and partner needs conflict
Equip partner sellers and solution architects to position Claude for a customer workload without escalating to us — segment-specific enablement, technical content, and the materials their field actually reaches for
Translate Anthropic positioning for partner surfaces, taking source messaging from Product Marketing and creating partner-specific versions that account for what's available where, what each partner needs to hear, and how the narrative lands on their platform

Work with Partnerships, Product, and partner-side teams to shape solutions into launchable moments, and make the call on which are worth a launch at all
Run launch execution – Manage cross-functional review cycles, support partner launch preparedness, compile post-launch reporting
Build post-launch momentum through partner webinars, technical content pipelines, and campaigns that keep partners selling after launch-day
Represent the partner perspective internally — surface Anthropic-direct launches that will affect partner relationships, flag partner-experience issues in product decisions, and make sure partner considerations arrive early rather than as a fire drill
Turn informal knowledge into documented, repeatable process as our release cadence and partner portfolio grow, and build the function so it scales beyond any one person
