For years, account-based marketing at Fresh Prints has been built around campaigns. We identify an opportunity, launch a program, measure the results, and rebuild the approach the following year. That is no longer enough.
Our highest-value accounts should not be managed as a series of campaigns. They need a long-term growth strategy: a clear view of which accounts deserve disproportionate investment, what will materially change their value, and how Fresh Prints should serve, retain, and expand them over time. Your job will be to build that strategy.
You will bring together customer insights, data, segmentation, and operational execution to determine where the biggest account growth opportunities exist and what the business must do to capture them. The goal is to build an account-growth system that becomes more intelligent, more effective, and more valuable with every cycle.
There is no established function to inherit and no finished playbook to manage. You will define what account-based marketing should mean for Fresh Prints, build the operating model behind it, and drive the business to execute against it across Marketing, Sales, Creative, Data, and Operations.
We are not looking for someone who will optimize the existing approach at the margins. We are looking for someone who will question its assumptions, identify the few bets that could materially change account value, and take responsibility for turning those bets into results.

Defining how Fresh Prints grows and retains its most valuable accounts at the company level, not simply running better campaigns.
Building an account strategy that continues to work as chapters, decision-makers, relationships, and buying cycles change.
Identifying the few highest-leverage bets that could materially increase account value, then focusing the business around them.
Turning strategy into execution through direct ownership, cross-functional influence, and systems that scale.
Shaping how Marketing, Sales, Operations, and account-facing teams approach retention, expansion, and long-term account development.
Building account growth into a durable business capability, not an initiative that resets every campaign cycle.
What You'll Own
Company-Level Account Strategy
Build the long-term growth strategy for Fresh Prints’ highest-value accounts.
Define how the business should identify, segment, prioritise, invest in, retain, and expand those accounts over time.
Develop a strategy that remains effective even as student leaders, decision-makers, buying committees, and internal account owners change.
Use customer insight, account data, and commercial judgment to identify the few opportunities that could materially change account value across the business.
Shape decisions across sales motions, customer experience, and account coverage when those decisions are necessary to unlock growth.
Turning Strategy Into Results
Take responsibility for moving the strategy from an idea into how the company actually operates.
This is not a role that ends with recommendations, presentations, or campaign briefs. You will stay close enough to execution to ensure the strategy produces measurable results.
Use AI, automation, process, and disciplined prioritisation to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.
Partner with Sales, BDM, Campus Manager leadership, Marketing, Creative, Data, and Operations to translate the strategy into clear actions, ownership, and operating rhythms.
Build the systems, decision rules, and playbooks that allow teams to execute the strategy correctly without depending on you to manage every action.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Represent account growth and retention in executive-level conversations.
Bring a clear, evidence-backed point of view on where the company should place its bets, what it should stop doing, and what needs to change.
Build the commercial case and organisational support required to secure resources, change priorities, and influence how teams operate.
Raise the quality of thinking and execution across teams you do not formally manage through clarity, judgment, and credibility.
Measure success through changes in retention, expansion, and account value, not simply through campaign delivery or short-term engagement metrics.

You think in systems, not isolated campaigns, and build strategies that outlast any individual relationship or decision-maker.
You have created a meaningful step-change in performance before, not only improved an established playbook at the margins.
You are comfortable entering an ambiguous problem, forming a strong point of view, and creating the path forward without precedent.
You can move from customer insight and data to clear strategic choices, then stay close enough to execution to make those choices real.
You know how to raise the performance of teams you do not manage through strong judgment, clear systems, and influence rather than formal authority.
You have the credibility to challenge assumptions, influence senior leaders, and push the business toward harder but higher-value decisions.
You take retention and expansion as seriously as acquisition and see all three as part of the same account-growth system.

5+ years of experience in account-based marketing, growth strategy, customer strategy, revenue strategy, or a related strategic role.
A track record of delivering significant, measurable improvements in account growth, retention, expansion, or customer value.
Evidence of building a new strategy, capability, or operating model rather than only managing an established function.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect customer insight, data, and business economics.
Experience driving meaningful outcomes across teams without relying on formal authority.
Strong executive communication, including presenting recommendations, challenging assumptions, and securing senior-level buy-in.
Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction without precedent, and being accountable for results without an established playbook.

Job Description
Reporting to the Senior Director of Marketing Enablement & Events, the Event Marketing Manager is responsible for planning and executing strategic event marketing programs that support Momentive's go-to-market objectives. This role leads the company's participation in trade shows, customer events, executive engagements, and industry conferences to generate pipeline, strengthen customer relationships, and elevate brand awareness.
Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success, and executive leadership, the Event Marketing Manager ensures every event delivers a consistent brand experience and measurable business impact. The ideal candidate is a collaborative marketer who combines strong business acumen with exceptional project management and thrives in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

Event Strategy & Marketing
Develop and execute an event marketing strategy aligned with business priorities and revenue goals.
Evaluate industry events, sponsorships, and speaking opportunities to recommend participation based on strategic value and expected ROI.
Build and manage the annual event calendar in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders.
Establish event objectives, KPIs, and success metrics that align with marketing and sales goals.
Continuously optimize the event portfolio through data, insights, and post-event analysis.
Event Planning & Execution
Lead end-to-end planning and execution of trade shows, customer events, executive programs, and industry conferences.
Manage all event logistics, including contracts, vendors, venues, exhibits, travel, shipping, and onsite operations.
Ensure events are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with Momentive's brand standards.
Prepare internal participants with communications, logistics, messaging, and expectations to ensure successful event execution.
Support additional corporate events and strategic initiatives as needed.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders throughout the event lifecycle.
Collaborate with Sales and BDR teams to maximize lead generation, engagement, and post-event follow-up.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, agencies, and strategic partners.
Foster knowledge sharing and continuous improvement across internal teams.
Performance & Operations
Measure event performance through pipeline influence, lead quality, engagement, attendance, and ROI.
Deliver post-event reports with recommendations for future improvements.
Manage event budgets, forecasts, contracts, purchase orders, and expenses in compliance with company policies.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and scale the event program.
Required Experience

3-5 years of experience in B2B event marketing, field marketing, or integrated marketing.
Experience planning and executing trade shows, conferences, customer events, or similar marketing programs.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and budget expectations.
Technical Skills
Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana or similar platforms.
Experience with event management software and marketing technology platforms.
Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Excel and PowerPoint.
Professional Competencies
Strong business acumen with an understanding of how events contribute to marketing and revenue objectives.
Strategic thinker with excellent project management and organizational skills.
Ability to analyze data and use insights to improve marketing performance.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to influence and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
Resourceful, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences.
Self-starter who takes ownership and drives projects to completion.

Experience marketing to associations, nonprofits, or SaaS organizations.
Experience supporting executive-level customer events.
Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) or integrated campaign execution.

Ability to travel up to 50% based on business and event needs.
Ability to occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 20 pounds.
Ability to stand for extended periods during event setup, exhibit hours, and teardown.
Ability to occasionally bend, kneel, push, pull, and move event equipment as needed.

Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions.

From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team.

World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.

Our Digital Marketing team is small, but powerful. We sit at the intersection of pipeline growth, segment marketing and brand experience, blending analytical rigor with creative energy. We are innovative and nimble to constant changes in the marketing landscape, driving key business results for the organization.

The Senior Performance Marketing Manager is pivotal in driving pipeline growth by bridging marketing and operations to develop and execute data-driven campaigns across PPC, Social, Display, and Video Advertising Platforms. This role emphasizes uncovering new growth opportunities to enhance campaign performance and profitability.

Key responsibilities include launching and optimizing campaigns across platforms such as Google, YouTube, 6Sense, Bing, OpenAI, Meta and others that come available. The candidate will ensure scalability, maximize ROI, and follow best practices in campaign setup and structure with the ability to leverage AI in support of your responsibilities.

The ideal candidate will have a solid background in performance marketing and channel management and be eager to expand their responsibilities within the Go-To-Market organization for a more integrated approach to driving growth. This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape our performance marketing strategy as we accelerate our growth trajectory, with meaningful autonomy over channel strategy and budget allocation within your portfolio.

Location: Remote within the US

Your Daily Adventures Will Include
Lead cross-functional partnership between Marketing and Operations to develop audience strategy, segmentation, and scalable performance marketing programs. Drive shared budget and KPI goals in the process.
Manage and optimize paid campaigns across various channels, including YouTube, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Display, LinkedIn, Meta and Connected TV (CTV).
Lead the development and execution of new channel and campaign experiments, identifying scalable opportunities to drive pipeline growth.
Lead budget tracking, performance goals, and cross-functional collaboration to achieve business results and key performance indicator (KPI) goals.
Create reports and monitor key performance metrics, including spend, revenue, return on ad spend (ROAS), and budgets.
Understand immediately what is working, what isn’t, and what might be broken, proposing new strategies and tactics to improve the ROAS.
Leverage customer segmentation and target market inputs to optimize media performance.
Work closely with creative, product marketing, and sales teams to develop high performing ads.
Manage portions of a budget in the range of $5M-8M per year.
Manage multiple agencies that support the execution of your strategies, while also having your own ability to execute in the different platforms as needed.
Serve as the strategic expert for our paid digital programs.
Our Vision Of You
Demonstrated history of delivering measurable results through performance marketing.
7+ years of experience in growth marketing/performance marketing.
Comfortable using AI-powered tools to inform media optimization, performance diagnostics, and audience segmentation, with curiosity to adopt new AI-driven platforms and techniques as they emerge.
Proficiency with Google, Youtube, LinkedIn, and Bing platforms is essential; familiarity with additional channels is a plus with an expectation that you are a quick learner .
Hands-on experience with CRM systems such as Salesforce.
Building ABM segments and campaigns is a strong plus.
Exceptional communication and organizational skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Strong proficiency with analytics tools and platforms.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We’re looking for a Solutions Marketing Manager to shape how LangChain brings its full platform to priority industries, enterprise buyers, and high-value use cases.
This role sits at the intersection of product and GTM. You’ll translate customer problems into clear solution narratives, repeatable sales plays, campaign themes, and customer-facing assets that help teams understand where LangChain fits in their AI strategy.
You’ll develop industry solutions, use case solutions, and enterprise solution stories for segments such as financial services, healthcare, life sciences, and other priority markets. You’ll work closely with sales, solutions, product, demand generation, field marketing, education, and customer teams to understand what matters in the field, turn those insights into messaging and collateral, and help create programs that support pipeline and revenue generation.
The role covers the full LangChain platform, including Observability & Evaluation, Deployment, Sandboxes, LLM Gateway, Fleet, Engine, and OSS. The goal is to explain how these products work together to help companies build, deploy, monitor, and improve agents in production.
You’ll define the problems we solve for specific audiences, package those into repeatable narratives, and help GTM teams take them to market.

Develop industry and use case solutions
Build solution narratives for priority industries and enterprise use cases. Initial focus areas include financial services, healthcare, and life sciences, with room to expand based on GTM priorities.
Translate customer problems into clear solution stories. You’ll connect LangChain’s platform capabilities to the business, operational, governance, and technical needs of specific audiences.
Define repeatable use case messaging. You’ll identify where agents can create value across functions and industries, then turn those patterns into solution briefs, use case pages, campaign assets, sales decks, webinar narratives, and customer-facing content.
Build a point of view on enterprise AI adoption. You’ll help explain how companies move from prototypes and isolated experiments to production deployments with the controls, visibility, and evaluation practices they need.
Stay close to the market. You’ll synthesize customer conversations, sales feedback, competitive activity, industry trends, and product signals into sharper messaging and GTM recommendations.
Support enterprise GTM motions
Partner with sales, solutions, field marketing, demand generation, and customer-facing teams on targeted enterprise campaigns and account motions.
Build sales enablement for industry and enterprise conversations. This may include talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, use case maps, executive-ready decks, demo narratives, and competitive context.
Turn field learnings into reusable sales plays. You’ll work with account teams to understand what resonates with buyers and turn those insights into repeatable messaging, collateral, and campaign programs.
Create materials for complex buying committees. You’ll help LangChain speak clearly to technical buyers, AI leaders, IT and security stakeholders, business leaders, and functional teams.
Support pipeline and revenue programs. You’ll help connect solution narratives to campaigns, events, webinars, ABM motions, field programs, and sales follow-up.

You have 3–6+ years of experience in solutions marketing, enterprise marketing, product marketing, developer marketing, industry marketing, or a related GTM role.
You’ve built messaging, collateral, or campaigns around technical products, AI/ML products, developer tools, B2B SaaS, infrastructure, automation, productivity tools, or platform products.
You can turn customer problems into clear solution narratives. You know how to move from “what the product does” to “why this matters for this audience, industry, or use case.”
You understand enterprise buying motions. You know how to create assets for complex buying committees, regulated industries, sales-led motions, and executive conversations.
You’re comfortable with technical products. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to learn technical concepts quickly, ask good questions, and translate details into customer-facing messaging.
You like working with sales and customer-facing teams. You’re interested in what happens in the field and know how to turn that feedback into stronger messaging and enablement.
You’re comfortable working across many audiences, including developers, technical buyers, operators, admins, AI leaders, business stakeholders, and nontechnical end users.
You can balance strategic thinking with execution. You can define a messaging POV, then build the deck, brief, landing page copy, or sales asset that brings it to life.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and iteration. The market for production-ready AI agents is still being defined, and you’re excited to ship, learn, and improve.
You have genuine curiosity about agents, enterprise AI adoption, and how they will change how teams work.

Experience building industry or solutions marketing programs for financial services, healthcare, life sciences, public sector, or other regulated industries.
Experience supporting enterprise sales teams through enablement, account-based campaigns, customer-facing storytelling, competitive support, or executive-facing collateral.
Familiarity with the LLM, agent, or AI application development ecosystem.
Experience with PLG motions, onboarding, activation, lifecycle marketing, or self-serve adoption.
You’ll help build the solutions marketing motion at LangChain. There is room to shape how we define priority industries, package use cases, support enterprise campaigns, and enable the field.

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.
PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.
Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day.

This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

About Cytix

Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

We're looking for our founding APAC Field Marketing Leader, someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.
The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.
Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.
Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.
What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.

Brings direct experience with both halves of this job. Pressure-test whether they built a durable function or just ran events, and whether they're still willing to be hands-on at the start.
The partner-led regional leader. Led co-marketing and demand programs through cloud providers, resellers, and distributors across APAC markets. Strongest on leverage and ecosystem motion. Pressure-test whether they can also build direct enterprise ABM and own a pipeline number independent of partners.
The multi-market APAC field marketing leader. Owned field marketing across several APAC sub-regions at a scaled tech company. Brings market fluency, local vendor and event relationships, and cultural range. Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.

Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.
Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.
Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.
At Hightouch , our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

Looking for a role where you can build something from scratch instead of inheriting someone else's playbook? We're hiring our first Competitive Intelligence Manager to own the competitive program end to end. You'll keep our field teams sharp with real-time intel, run sales enablement that reps actually use, feed competitive signals into product and roadmap decisions, and shape campaigns that make it obvious why we win.
As our Competitive Intelligence Lead, you'll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Product Management to keep us ahead of the market. If you like owning a function nobody's built yet, turning scattered competitor noise into a clear point of view, and being the person sales calls before a big deal, this is your role.

Create and define differentiating positioning for our products and solutions for our various personas (ex: marketing teams, product teams, data teams etc)
Run point on cross-functional launches and campaigns across marketing, sales, and product
Conduct user research to identify gaps in the market for our product to fill
Create, maintain, and improve website messaging, customer case studies, and sales enablement materials
Help internal teams and product evangelists craft messaging and sequences that align with customer value
Externally evangelize Hightouch at field events, customer engagements, and webinars

4-6 years in competitive intelligence, product marketing, or market research, ideally in B2B SaaS
Strong primary and secondary research skills (win/loss interviews, analyst reports, public filings, review sites, pricing pages); ability to synthesize messy, conflicting signals into a clear point of view; comfortable building and maintaining structured frameworks (battlecards, comparison matrices, positioning maps).
Proven track record of producing content that sales and marketing actually use — battlecards, competitive decks, objection handling guides
Storytelling: Proficient in turning complex, technology-heavy topics into digestible, compelling stories that resonate with target audiences
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for crafting clear, persuasive messaging
Cross-functional fluency: has worked closely with sales (win/loss, deal support), product (roadmap and positioning input), and marketing (messaging, launches); understands sales cycles well enough to know what reps need in the moment, not just what's "interesting."
Domain fit: familiarity with data infrastructure, CDPs, MarTech, or adjacent technical B2B markets.

We’re looking for a Senior Ads Product Marketing Manager to shape the future of performance bidding, optimization, and measurement at Pinterest. You’ll own the go-to-market strategy for new solutions that help advertisers align campaign delivery with the business outcomes they value most.
In this role, you’ll translate complex advertiser measurement needs into clear product strategy, positioning, and scalable go-to-market motions.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Measurement, Sales, Performance Solutions, and Product Operations to bring new lower-funnel solutions from early testing through broader adoption.

Your work will help advertisers optimize toward the outcomes that matter in their own measurement source of truth—and build greater confidence in Pinterest as a performance channel.

Own product marketing strategy and go-to-market execution for Pinterest’s measurement-aligned bidding and optimization portfolio, including MPO, Last Click Mode/optimization windows, and future custom conversion solutions.
Build a deep understanding of advertiser measurement approaches, attribution models, lower-funnel objectives, and performance needs to identify high-value market opportunities and influence product strategy.
Define target segments, customer problems, value propositions, positioning, messaging, and proof points for early-stage and scaled bidding products.
Lead commercialization for alpha and beta programs: shape learning agendas, define advertiser eligibility and recruitment strategies, develop onboarding and enablement materials, and turn findings into product and GTM recommendations.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Measurement teams to translate market insights into product requirements, prioritize investments, and navigate technical and commercial tradeoffs.
Serve as the voice of advertisers and Sales to Product, and the voice of Product to Sales—synthesizing customer feedback, competitive intelligence, product data, and opportunity sizing into decision-ready recommendations.
Develop clear narratives, sales enablement, training, and customer-facing materials that make complex bidding, optimization, and measurement concepts accessible and actionable.
Establish success metrics across adoption, advertiser performance, sentiment, revenue impact, and operational readiness; use results to refine product strategy and determine the path from alpha to beta to broader scale.
Drive cross-functional alignment across Sales, Performance Solutions, Measurement Solutions, Product Operations, Business Marketing, Legal, and other partners to deliver cohesive, scalable product launches.
Use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate market research, customer-feedback synthesis, and analysis, while applying sound judgment, validating outputs, and maintaining ownership of final recommendations.

5+ years of product marketing, ads marketing, or related experience, ideally in performance advertising, ad delivery, bidding, measurement, attribution, or marketing technology.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience developing and executing product go-to-market strategies, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, enablement, launch planning, and adoption measurement.
Experience bringing early-stage products or features through alpha, beta, and broader commercialization; comfort operating when product-market fit, product scope, and operating models are still evolving.
Strong understanding of lower-funnel advertising, conversion optimization, CPA/ROAS, attribution, and first- and third-party measurement approaches.
Technical fluency to understand and communicate how conversion signals, data integrations, attribution windows, optimization models, and bidding strategies affect advertiser outcomes.
Strong analytical judgment and experience using qualitative and quantitative data to define customer needs, size opportunities, evaluate test outcomes, and make strategic recommendations.
Proven ability to influence and build trusted partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Solutions, Operations, and executive stakeholders.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve research, analysis, or workflow efficiency while validating accuracy, protecting sensitive information, and retaining ownership of final work.

We’re looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to help drive customer acquisition and growth across Talkspace’s Member and NYC Teenspace programs, with a primary focus on Paid Social and Programmatic media and emerging channels.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Growth Marketing, this role will own the day-to-day strategy, execution, optimization, and performance of channels including but not limited to Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Programmatic Display, and Connected TV (CTV).

This is a hands-on role for a performance marketer who loves digging into data, understanding what is driving performance, and continuously finding ways to improve results.

You’ll work closely with internal Creative and Analytics teams as well as agencies, vendors, and platform partners to execute campaigns, develop testing strategies, and identify opportunities to improve acquisition efficiency and scale.

The ideal candidate combines strong channel expertise with analytical curiosity and understands that great performance marketing goes beyond what is reported within an advertising platform. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.
This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

Own Paid Social & Programmatic Performance
Lead the day-to-day strategy, execution, and optimization of Talkspace’s Paid Social and Programmatic acquisition programs.
Manage campaigns across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Programmatic Display, and CTV, as well as emerging channels and opportunities that fall outside of the core ad platforms as they relate to different initiatives. .
Manage toward key acquisition goals including member volume, CAC/CPA, conversion rate, and overall media efficiency.
Own campaign structure, audience strategy, bidding, placements, budget pacing, and ongoing optimization across assigned channels.
Monitor performance closely and proactively identify opportunities, risks, and emerging trends.
Partner with agencies, vendors, and platform representatives to ensure campaigns are executed effectively and continuously optimized.
Maintain strong platform and campaign hygiene, including QA, tracking, naming conventions, pacing, and performance monitoring.
Support Senior Director of Growth Marketing with ad hoc / initiative specific media tests as needed.
Analyze & Optimize Performance
Analyze performance across channels, campaigns, audiences, creative and placements understand what is driving results.
Proactively diagnose performance changes and develop recommendations for improvement.
Look beyond platform-reported metrics to understand traffic quality, conversion behavior, and downstream acquisition outcomes that relate to broader business metrics.
Partner with Analytics to evaluate performance using internal reporting and measurement tools.
Identify opportunities to improve CAC, increase conversion, and scale acquisition efficiently.
Develop clear performance narratives that explain what happened, why it happened, and what we should do next.
Proactively surface anomalies, risks, and opportunities to Growth Marketing leadership.
Leverage AI Tools to enhance analytical rigor.
Drive Creative Testing & Optimization
Partner closely with Creative to develop a consistent pipeline of performance-focused creative across Paid Social and Programmatic channels.
Translate channel performance, audience insights, and creative learnings into actionable creative briefs and recommendations.
Identify creative fatigue and proactively recommend refreshes, iterations, and new concepts.
Develop structured creative testing plans across messaging, formats, hooks, audiences, calls-to-action, and other variables.
Analyze creative performance and translate learnings into recommendations for future production.
Ensure assets are developed and adapted according to channel-specific formats and best practices.
Partner with internal and external creative resources to ensure campaigns have the assets needed to maintain performance and testing velocity.
Identify opportunities to efficiently scale creative production through modular asset development, creator/UGC partnerships, AI-enabled workflows / creative iteration, and external production resources.
Collaborate with Senior Director of Growth Marketing and Creative stakeholders to ensure performance creative supports Talkspace’s broader growth strategy and brand experience.
Partner with creative in developing processes that allow for strong volume velocity of creative output, with AI assistance
Lead Testing & Channel Development
Develop and execute structured testing roadmaps across audiences, creative, placements, bidding strategies, campaign structures, and new platform capabilities.
Establish clear hypotheses and success criteria for tests and translate results into actionable recommendations.
Identify opportunities to expand or evolve Talkspace’s Paid Social and Programmatic channel mix.
Evaluate emerging platforms, ad products, targeting capabilities, and media opportunities.
Partner with Growth leadership and Analytics on broader measurement and incrementality initiatives.
Document learnings and ensure successful tests are translated into scalable strategies.
Manage Budgets & Forecasting
Own day-to-day budget pacing across assigned channels against monthly and quarterly plans.
Monitor spend and acquisition performance closely and identify pacing risks or opportunities.
Develop channel-level forecasts and performance expectations in partnership with Growth leadership.
Recommend budget reallocations based on performance, marginal efficiency, and opportunities to scale.
Provide clear visibility into how assigned channels are tracking against acquisition and efficiency targets.
Partner Across the Acquisition Funnel
Monitor the customer journey beyond the initial media interaction to understand how traffic converts through the acquisition funnel.
Partner with Analytics and other cross-functional teams to identify potential drivers of conversion changes.
Distinguish between channel-level performance issues and broader funnel, site, tracking, or conversion trends.
Use funnel insights to inform audience, media, creative, and optimization strategies.
Communicate & Collaborate
Develop concise weekly and monthly performance updates highlighting results, key drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended next steps.
Translate complex channel performance into clear, actionable insights for Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Partner closely with Creative, Analytics, Product, and other Marketing teams to advance acquisition priorities.

Obsidian Security is the leading SaaS security platform, trusted by global enterprises like Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Algolia. We protect 200+ organizations across North America, Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand, including many of the world’s largest Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies.
Founded in 2017 and backed by top investors like Greylock, Obsidian was built to close a critical gap: securing SaaS apps where business happens—Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and hundreds more. The company does this by offering a complete SaaS security platform to reduce risk, detect and respond to threats, and prevent breaches at the source.

Obsidian was built by leaders who redefined endpoint and identity security at CrowdStrike, Okta, Cylance, and Carbon Black. Now, they’re transforming how SaaS is secured.
With AI driving rapid SaaS growth and complexity, agentic AI tools gain privileged access to sensitive data through integrations, creating new risks most security tools miss. Obsidian uniquely detects anomalous OAuth token activity and manages integration risks. Major announcements are on the horizon. Recognizing that SaaS security needs to evolve, Obsidian enables growing organizations to start with a lightweight, prevention-focused browser extension and expand coverage over time.
With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and a major fundraise ahead, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.
We are hiring a Sr Technical Marketing Manager - Alliances & Competitive Strategy to own two of the highest-leverage narratives at Obsidian: why we are better together with our strategic partners, and why our architecture solves problems no one else can.
This role sits at the intersection of alliances marketing and technical product marketing, and it owns competitive intelligence for the company.

You will define how Obsidian shows up alongside our strategic technology alliances, building the joint value propositions, launch narratives, and enablement that turn partnerships into pipeline and supporting the GTM models that bring those alliances to market.

At the same time, you will go deep with Product and Engineering to understand how the platform works, from our knowledge graph to our data depth and detection architecture, and elevate that "how" into a durable "why": why Obsidian is uniquely positioned to secure third-party applications and AI agents where alternative architectures structurally fall short.
You will be the positioning authority the field, our partners, and our executives turn to for evidence-based answers on how we win, both in architecture and in direct competition.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can think strategically, move quickly, and help shape how we scale both partner marketing and competitive positioning at Obsidian.
What you’ll accomplish
Own the Alliance Narrative
Develop joint positioning, messaging, and better-together value propositions for strategic technology alliances
Build messaging that helps customers understand when and why to adopt Obsidian alongside partner platforms, and helps alliance partners position Obsidian with clarity and conviction
Lead product marketing for joint launches, co-marketing campaigns, and major alliance field moments, coordinating across alliances, product, and marketing teams
Support the GTM models behind each alliance, including marketplace, co-sell, and integration motions, with the positioning, content, and enablement they need to perform
Create enablement that alliance sellers actually use: solution briefs, pitch decks, objection-handling guides, and co-branded campaign materials
Drive co-marketing programs with strategic alliances that deliver measurable pipeline contribution and deal acceleration
Own Competitive Intelligence & Technical Positioning
Own the competitive intelligence function: monitor competitor products, architectures, disclosures, and market signals, and distill them into succinct, actionable guidance for sales, product, and leadership
Build and maintain the compete program, including battlecards, compete decks, objection handling, and win/loss insights, that gives the field and partners clear evidence for why Obsidian wins
Elevate "how we do things" into "why it matters": articulate why Obsidian's architecture solves problems that point tools and adjacent platforms cannot
Develop technical marketing content such as architecture narratives, technical briefs, blogs, webinars, and demos that proves differentiation rather than asserting it
Bring competitive and market insights back into product, alliances, and executive planning to sharpen roadmap framing and GTM strategy

Technical to the core, fluent in the "why." 8+ years in product, technical, or partner marketing in cybersecurity or enterprise software, ideally with a hands-on technical background.
A competitive strategist. You have built compete programs and turn competitor analysis and win/loss data into positioning the field trusts. You know the difference between a feature comparison and a structural advantage.
Experienced in technology alliance marketing. You have built better-together narratives, joint launches, and enablement with strategic technology partners, and understand marketplace, co-sell, and integration GTM motions.
Fluent in the cybersecurity buyer. You know how security leaders evaluate and buy, and how to help alliance partners have that conversation on Obsidian's behalf.
Strategic, hands-on, and collaborative. You see the big picture but are comfortable writing, building, and shipping the work yourself, and you align alliances, sales, product, and engineering without owning all the decisions.

As a Sr. Industry Marketing Manager at Databricks, you will guide messaging, content and GTM programs for the Startup segment. You will work with sales, partners, VCs, accelerators and our customers to build awareness, demand generation and sales enablement programs that help achieve pipeline goals.

You will also build the credibility engine for this audience through founder and engineering-led content, developer channels, community programs, and startup and investor events. This role reports to the Sr. Director of Industry Solutions Marketing.

The impact you will have
Establish a startup-segment positioning and content framework used consistently across priority sales, partner, developer, field, and demand-generation programs, with adoption measured through program usage and stakeholder feedback.
Meet or exceed agreed pipeline and consumption targets for priority startup accounts through integrated account-based, partner, venture, demand-generation, and field programs.
Build an active venture and accelerator ecosystem that generates measurable portfolio reach, co-marketing activity, qualified opportunities, and sourced or influenced pipeline.
Improve the conversion of startup evaluations into committed production spend by optimizing credits, trials, free-tier, and other product-led motions, measured through activation, conversion, and expansion rates.
Increase awareness and technical credibility with startup founders, developers, and technical leaders, measured through target-audience engagement, community participation, content-assisted opportunities, and event outcomes.
Equip go-to-market teams with startup-specific messaging, technical proof points, sales plays, and enablement that improve seller adoption and segment performance, including conversion, win rate, or sales-cycle metrics.
Expand the segment’s customer and community proof through credible startup stories, technical content, speaking engagements, and investor or developer events that contribute to reach, engagement, and pipeline.
What we look for
7+ years of experience marketing technology to startups, developers, or the venture ecosystem, or equivalent experience building and scaling a venture-backed startup.
A proven record of owning marketing strategy for a segment, product line, or go-to-market motion and delivering measurable pipeline, adoption, consumption, or revenue outcomes.
Experience developing positioning, messaging, and content for complex technical B2B products and translating cloud, data, analytics, or AI/ML capabilities into clear customer use cases and business outcomes.
Technical fluency in modern data and AI architectures, including the technologies and buying considerations relevant to model providers, agent frameworks, vector search, evaluation tooling, and production workloads.
Demonstrated success building relationships with venture firms, accelerators, incubators, startup communities, customers, or strategic partners to drive awareness, co-marketing, adoption, or pipeline.
Working knowledge of venture-backed company buying dynamics, including funding stages, budget and runway pressures, buying authority, and triggers that accelerate or stop infrastructure and AI platform decisions.
Experience with product-led and consumption-based growth motions, including self-serve funnels, trials, credits, free tiers, and the path from technical evaluation to committed spend.
Experience leading cross-functional programs and presenting credibly to founders, technical leaders, investors, sales teams, and partners while balancing strategic direction with fast, hands-on execution.

Vanta's Product Marketing team sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success. We define positioning and narrative for Vanta's platform, translate roadmap into go-to-market motions across big launch moments and releases, and make sure the field can sell what Product is building; with research, storytelling, and cross-functional partnership as the core of how we work.

AI is one of Vanta's most strategic bets, and it needs a dedicated owner. This PMM will be focused on bringing the AI roadmap to market in close partnership with EPD. You'll own the narrative, messaging, and positioning for Vanta’s AI story end-to-end, and be the connective tissue between what Engineering and Product are building and how the market, field, and customers understand it.
You're expected to shape our AI story and define Vanta as a leader in the space, which means you’re fast-moving and nimble, have enough technical fluency to have a real point of view in roadmap conversations with EPD (including getting hands-on and testing the product yourself), paired with the storytelling and creativity to bring a unique, differentiated story to market.

About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation.

Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Role Description
Dropbox is hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, AI & ISV Ecosystem to help define how Dropbox shows up in the next generation of AI-powered work. As AI and productivity platforms rapidly reshape how people create, access, and collaborate around content, this role will lead some of Dropbox’s most important ecosystem marketing opportunities.

You will develop joint go-to-market strategies and high-impact programs with strategic technology partners—including OpenAI, Anthropic , and other leading AI and productivity platforms—while unlocking new growth opportunities across Dropbox’s broader integration ecosystem.
You will lead and develop a small team of partner marketers, operating as a true player-coach: setting direction, prioritizing the biggest opportunities, creating the conditions for your team to do their best work, and helping them grow as strategic marketers, while also contributing to hands-on execution.

You will also serve as a senior marketing partner across Business Development, Partnerships, Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Communications, turning technical integrations and partnership opportunities into compelling customer stories, differentiated value propositions, and integrated programs that drive adoption, awareness, pipeline, and growth.
This role owns partner-specific go-to-market strategy, joint positioning, integrated activation, evergreen co-marketing, and performance optimization for Dropbox’s priority AI and ISV relationships; partner selection, commercial agreements, product-roadmap decisions, sales execution, and partner-systems administration remain owned by the corresponding Business Development, Product, Sales, and Operations teams.
This role is designed for a strategic builder, creative marketer, and people leader who thrives where technology, partnerships, and go-to-market intersect. You will identify where Dropbox can create disproportionate value across the ecosystem, shape joint strategies with influential external partners, and lead complex initiatives from early opportunity through launch, activation, measurement, and scale.
You will join Dropbox at a pivotal moment as AI changes how people interact with their content and where work gets done. This is an opportunity to help shape Dropbox’s position in the emerging AI ecosystem, work alongside some of the world’s most influential technology companies, build a high-impact team, and create the partner marketing models that will help define Dropbox’s next phase of growth.
AI is already embedded in this workflow. You will use approved AI tools to accelerate partner research, insight synthesis, campaign ideation, content development, launch planning, and performance analysis—and you will help build better AI-enabled workflows for the team while maintaining rigorous human judgment, review, and accountability.

Set the strategy and build the roadmap : Closely partner with Business Development to define the partner strategy, and own Dropbox’s partner marketing strategy across priority AI and ISV partners, translate business and customer priorities into a clear portfolio of bets, and create the roadmap, prioritization criteria, and operating approach needed to execute against them.
Personally build and execute high-priority programs : Lead the most strategic and complex partner marketing initiatives from concept through launch and optimization, including developing joint value propositions, campaign briefs, go-to-market plans, content strategies, activation plans, and partner-facing deliverables—not simply directing the work from a distance.

This manager personally leads programs that are highly ambiguous, executive-visible, or strategically consequential, while direct reports own defined partner programs end to end.
Create an evergreen co-marketing engine: Build repeatable programs that extend strategic partnerships beyond launch moments, including joint campaigns, customer stories, lifecycle activation, events, content, partner amplification, and other motions that drive sustained awareness, adoption, engagement, pipeline, and revenue objectives.
Turn strategy into scalable operating mechanisms: Design and implement partner segmentation, reusable launch frameworks and templates, decision rights, operating cadences, measurement approaches, campaign governance, and joint investment planning that help the team move faster and scale successful programs across the ecosystem.
Lead partners and cross-functional execution: Build trusted relationships with strategic partners and work hands-on with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, make tradeoffs, and drive complex programs to completion.
Lead, coach, and work alongside the team: Manage and develop partner marketers while remaining close enough to the work to unblock execution, raise the quality bar, coach through difficult partner situations, model strong craft, and step directly into priority programs when senior-level ownership is needed.
Build AI-enabled ways of working: Use approved AI tools directly in partner research, synthesis, planning, content development, personalization, and analysis; identify and implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for the team; and maintain clear human review and accountability for strategy, quality, partner commitments, and business outcomes.

B2B marketing experience: 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in partner, ecosystem, platform, or strategic alliances marketing, with demonstrated ability to set strategy and then personally build the plans, programs, processes, and deliverables required to execute it.
Deep partner marketing craft: Demonstrated experience developing joint value propositions, go-to-market strategies, integrated campaigns, launch plans, and evergreen co-marketing programs with technology, SaaS, platform, AI, or ISV partners.
Strong execution under ambiguity: Proven ability to take an underdefined opportunity, create structure, determine what needs to be built, and drive work from initial concept through execution, measurement, iteration, and scale.
Analytical and data-informed decision-making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize performance data, customer and partner insights, market signals, and qualitative inputs to evaluate opportunities, diagnose performance, make prioritization decisions, and determine what to scale, change, or stop.
Exceptional writing, messaging, and communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop, translate, and critically review joint messaging with partners; distill complex product and ecosystem concepts into clear customer value propositions; and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions effectively to senior internal and external stakeholders.
Cross-functional influence and player-coach leadership: Experience building trust and driving decisions across partners, Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing while managing and developing high-performing marketers, raising the quality bar, and stepping directly into complex work when senior ownership is needed.

About Faire
Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline.

At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores.

With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire is building an AI-enabled talent organization, hiring the people shaping the future of personalized commerce for retailers and brands around the world. We're looking for a Talent Brand Manager to build our employer value proposition and turn it into one cohesive talent brand strategy across all of our digital surfaces: LinkedIn, our careers site, social, Glassdoor, and increasingly, the AI tools candidates now use to research and compare offers.
This is a hands-on, builder role. You'll shape Faire's EVP, then build the systems that carry it to our employees, like building AI tools that make it easy for employees to tell their own stories and put our leaders' voices in front of candidates.

You will also develop an AEO strategy that ensures Faire shows up as the clear, authentic answer when candidates ask LLMs to learn more about the company and compare offers. You'll give recruiters that same enablement, arming them with the narrative and objection-handling they need to authentically represent Faire in the market.
You'll report to Jenny Talwar, Head of Talent, and be based in San Francisco.

Architect our employer value proposition: Define a compelling "why Faire, why now" narrative tailored for key hiring areas, beginning with our Engineering, Product, Design, and Data teams. Highlighting the broad range of backgrounds of the retailers and brands we serve, so the workforce we build increasingly reflects the diversity and vibrancy of our customers.
Create a unified digital footprint: Orchestrate high-impact campaigns across LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and our careers site to ensure a consistent talent brand backed by measurable performance indicators.
Establish Answer Engine Optimization: Develop an AEO framework to ensure Faire’s culture and opportunities are accurately and prominently represented within LLMs.
Champion the talent brand identity: Act as a steward for our voice, ensuring every job description and candidate touchpoint aligns perfectly with Faire’s established brand guidelines.
Scalable storytelling: Establish a repeatable engine for surfacing authentic stories from our leaders and employees that showcase our values, incredible internal mobility stories, and give a real glimpse into life at Faire.
Empower the front line: Create a comprehensive self-serve toolkit for recruiters and hiring managers, including audience-specific positioning and narrative-driven objection handling.
Build AI-powered enablers: Launch internal tools that leverage AI to help every Faire employee transform their personal experiences into polished, social-ready content.
Measure and iterate: Rigorously track candidate sentiment and conversion data to evaluate the effectiveness of our talent brand investments on hiring success.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Marketing and Comms partners to ensure a seamless integration of our employer brand across the business.

5+ years building employer brand, talent marketing, or recruitment marketing programs, ideally from the ground up
Experience running a cohesive brand strategy across owned and earned digital channels: careers site, LinkedIn, social, and Glassdoor
Comfortable building self-serve, custom AI tools for individual and team use, and applying them to drive productivity and scale
Understands how AI-driven search and answer engines (AEO/GEO) shape how a brand's content surfaces, and wants to build that muscle for talent brand

GoCardless is a global bank payment company. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking.

With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

GoCardless has a fast-growing Partner Programme — hundreds of technology, referral and reseller partners worldwide that don’t have a direct Partner Account Manager at GoCardless. Marketing to them today is mostly manual and one-off. We want someone to fix that.
You’ll expand our resources on the Partner Portal, building the campaigns, content and playbooks that let partners market GoCardless to their own customers without needing bespoke support every time, and you’ll run the newsletters and webinars that keep the wider partner base engaged. You’ll report to Freya Steveni (Partner Marketing Manager) in Commercial Demand Generation, working closely with our Partner Programme Manager and partner marketing leads in the UK&I, North America and France.
It’s a global remit, based in Leeds, with plenty of room to make it your own.

Design always-on campaigns partners can pick up and run themselves — email, co-branded content, digital.
Build the co-marketing playbooks and assets our regional teams reuse and localise.
Run partner comms and engagement — newsletters, webinars, the touchpoints that keep partners informed and active.
Turn one-off partner marketing requests into repeatable programmes, working with our Partner Account teams.
Support the Partner Events Manager on cross-partner events, from on-site support, to providing marketing assets and data upload.
Track what’s working — sign-ups, partner-sourced pipeline, merchant activation and retention.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara's Connected Operations platform helps organizations that depend on physical operations — fleets, construction, utilities, public works, and first responders — run safer, more efficiently, and more sustainably.
We're looking for a Sr. Manager, Product Marketing Manager, Public Sector to own the narrative, positioning, and enablement that will define how Samsara wins in government. You'll be the team's expert on how public sector buyers evaluate technology — from the contract vehicles they procure through, to the compliance bar they hold vendors to, to the mission outcomes they're ultimately accountable for.
This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who already understands government and frameworks like FedRAMP and StateRAMP/GovRAMP. The ideal candidate is someone who wants to build a public sector product marketing motion, not just execute inside one that already exists.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S. We prefer candidates based in or near Washington, D.C., or those able to work Eastern time zone hours.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will have real-world stakes — helping public agencies keep roads plowed, fleets safe, and essential services running for the communities they serve.
You're fluent in how the government buys technology: You understand procurement cycles, contract vehicles, and compliance frameworks well enough to turn them into a go-to-market advantage rather than a blocker.
You're energized by building, not just executing: Samsara's federal go-to-market motion is still being defined — you'll have real ownership over the frameworks, positioning, and playbooks that shape it.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You'll be surrounded by a high-caliber team that pushes you to do your best work.

Lead as a player-coach: Manage a direct report while helping build the public sector PMM team's foundation — sharing in the strategic work, coaching for growth, and creating the frameworks that enable the function to scale.
Own public sector positioning and messaging: Develop and evolve Samsara's core narrative for government buyers across federal, state, local, and education segments — grounded in mission outcomes rather than generic product benefits
Build Samsara's federal go-to-market foundation: Partner cross-functionally to define how Samsara approaches the federal market, including messaging and enablement that reflect our compliance roadmap as it evolves
Translate compliance into a sales advantage: Understand the FedRAMP authorization process and impact levels — deeply enough to explain it clearly to sales teams and prospects, and to inform internal conversations about authorization strategy and timing
Drive product and platform launches for public sector: Localize Samsara's launches for a government audience, ensuring messaging reflects agency use cases, procurement realities, and compliance considerations
Enable sales and channel teams: Build battlecards, objection-handling guides, RFP/RFI response content, and compliance-focused sales collateral that helps account teams and channel partners win competitive government deals
Support competitive intelligence for public sector: Track how competitors position themselves to government buyers, and translate that intelligence into differentiated Samsara messaging and sales guidance
Represent Samsara at public sector events and forums: Support flagship industry events and partner conferences with content, speaking support, and thought leadership

Working knowledge of the FedRAMP authorization process, and general familiarity with adjacent compliance frameworks (e.g., StateRAMP/GovRAMP, NIST 800-53), with the ability to translate them into clear guidance for internal teams
Proven ability to independently own strategic programs from conception to completion, and to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority

RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.
We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

RevenueCat helps apps of all shapes and sizes make more money across mobile, the web, and a growing list of other platforms like Roku, Amazon, and even AR through support for Vision Pro. As a result, many different types of users log in and use RevenueCat on a day-to-day basis. Product managers, support reps, lifecycle marketers, user acquisition specialists, data analysts, executives: the list goes on.
Communicating the growing breadth of use cases supported by RevenueCat in a way that makes sense for all those different types of businesses, apps, and users is a challenge. And that’s where product marketing comes in.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team led by Francie . This role is perfect for someone who:
Knows APIs and SDKs like their ABCs. Code may not be your craft, but you know how to talk the talk. Software developers are one of our core audiences, and they can smell BS a mile away. You can debug marketing messaging so it resonates with technical audiences, and craft narratives around the 1’s and 0’s that still land with business stakeholders.
Captains their own ship. You have a strong bias toward action and you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty on execution. Whether it’s juggling strategic and tactical work or navigating shifting priorities, you thrive on autonomy and love making things happen.
Distills collaborative chaos. You’re comfortable raising your hand and getting what you need from a dynamic and technical organization. Whether it’s nudging engineers for product updates or rallying Sales for customer stories, you can navigate the chaos and advocate for what the GTM org needs.
Gets excited about the unexpected. At RevenueCat we take shipping seriously, and are constantly adapting our product and strategies to meet the needs of developers. You see changes in direction and shifts in strategy as an opportunity to flex your creative muscles and learn on the fly.
Is a little quirky. You love a whimsical side quest and you can see the soft side of software. We pride ourselves in keeping our community on their toes with unique swag, challenges and events. You can play as big a role as you’d like in helping to brainstorm and bring these quirky concepts to life.
What You’ll Be Responsible For
GTM and adoption campaigns: Own key product areas to deeply understand the features we’re launching and the use cases and needs behind them. Craft compelling communication plans both within the organization, and to existing and prospective customers.
Lifecycle campaign building: Working with our marketing operations team to execute insight-based lifecycle campaigns to drive adoption, retention and community.
Web page design and optimization: Translate product messaging and customer understanding into visually compelling and highly converting web experiences with the help of our external web development agency. You’ll chart the vision for the story our website tells and the illustrations, animations and tools we create to convey it.
Case studies and testimonials: Organizing, facilitating, and translating customer interviews into compelling case studies and testimonials that showcase the value of RevenueCat.
Internal enablement: As an expert in your areas of product focus, you’ll empower developer-facing teams with the resources and training they need to support developers and ensure their success.
Market insights: Keeping your finger on the pulse of the mobile app industry and competitors to inform go-to-market strategies and uncover new opportunities for growth.
Whimsical side quests: Taking on unique projects with minimal instruction, coordinating the collection of 1000 screenshots to launch Paywalls.com , designing, printing and shipping a calendar of cat photos, hosting the World Paywall Speed Building Championships , or crafting a keynote speech for leadership. You’ll get to work on projects that stretch your creative muscles.
What You’ll Need to Be Successful
5+ years of experience in Product Marketing within a B2B or B2D SaaS environment, preferably targeting developers or software companies.
Previous experience as a solo-marketer is preferred. While you’ll have the broader marketing and product marketing teams to lean on, our async, entrepreneurial culture is best suited to someone who is comfortable independently driving projects forward, making progress amid changing processes, and actively enlisting cross-functional support when needed.
Experience owning end-to-end go-to-market efforts, including tier 1 product launches. Strong project management skills to prioritize multiple initiatives and execute effectively across teams.
Strong creative instincts and direction. You’ve led the charge on web design work and aren’t afraid to sketch, prototype in Figma, or use AI tools to get to an ugly starting point. Comfortable collaborating with external creative agencies and freelancers to deliver high-quality assets.
Excellent editorial judgment: you understand audience, tone, and communication objectives, and you can elevate copy through clear direction and feedback. You will not need to write everything yourself, but you’re comfortable jumping in to draft a narrative outline or even a blog post when necessary, and you know when to pass work forward to the content team or a technical writer
Exceptional communication skills to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and buy-in from key stakeholders.
A proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling messaging that resonates with different audiences, both internally and externally.
The resourcefulness to take on unique, sometimes ambiguous projects that require initiative and problem-solving.
